name: Meta AI
summary: Meta's AI assistant for questions, image generation and editing, available on the web and in Meta apps.
description: Meta AI is the assistant built by Meta and offered on meta.ai as well as inside Meta's apps. It answers questions in a chat interface, generates and edits images from text prompts, and helps with everyday tasks such as finding places or comparing products listed on Marketplace. Access is free with a Meta account.
